findings.title: Explicit empty any_of matchers are erased and broaden selectors
findings.observation: Truthiness parsing converts explicit empty or falsey wrong-type any_of values to None, bypassing the validator and removing the attribute constraint.
findings.trigger: A TOML or JSON override contains any_of=[] or another falsey malformed value.
findings.impact: A wrong-label control can resolve at confidence 1.0 and become an action target instead of rejecting the override.

evidence.description: Wrong label Settings resolved with parsedAnyOf null and confidence 1.0; probe exit 31.

findings.remediation: Parse by key presence and reject empty or wrong-type any_of before profile activation.
findings.verification: Parser, override, resolver, and action-path tests must reject all empty/falsey malformed variants before query.

findings.title: Non-finite profile numbers bypass confidence validation
findings.observation: NaN and infinities pass numeric parsing and comparison-based validation; NaN confidence is accepted because confidence < minimum is false.
findings.trigger: A TOML-compatible nan or infinity appears in a confidence, weight, distance, or frame numeric field.
findings.impact: A candidate that fails intended confidence evidence can resolve and expose non-JSON-safe diagnostics.

evidence.description: A failed selected constraint with structure_weight nan returned resolved and confidence nan; probe exit 31.

findings.remediation: Reject every non-finite numeric value during parsing or validation.
findings.verification: nan, inf, and -inf must fail across all numeric profile fields before query; finite boundaries remain positive controls.

findings.title: Malformed or contradictory query envelopes normalize as success
findings.observation: The normalizer ignores status and malformed failure kinds, treats present non-Boolean available as absent, drops malformed nodes, and erases malformed diagnostics before downstream truthiness checks.
findings.trigger: Examples include available string false, available true plus status failed, or numeric failureKind with a matching node.
findings.impact: A version-skewed or malformed lower-layer envelope can produce an actionable selector target and a later WeChat click.

evidence.description: All three malformed or contradictory envelopes returned resolved; probe exit 41.

findings.remediation: Validate schema, field presence/types, contradictions, every node, diagnostics, and truncation before legacy normalization.
findings.verification: Producer-to-resolver-to-WeChat malformed/version-skew matrix must return structured failure and zero mutations, with explicit valid legacy controls.

findings.title: Unverified search-result sets can reach Return, draft, and submit
findings.observation: Frame filtering occurs before ambiguity, zero verified candidates use unbound Return, malformed frames are normalized toward usable coordinates, and title verification cannot distinguish same-name contacts.
findings.trigger: Empty, offscreen, missing-frame, malformed-frame, malformed-nodes, or two-match-one-offscreen search results.
findings.impact: The wrong or unverified conversation can be opened and then receive drafted and submitted user text.

evidence.description: Six unsafe candidate sets completed draft and submit while the two-valid-match control correctly blocked; matrix exit 44.
Offscreen-only full send executed query, Return, verification, draft, and submit; exit 41.

findings.remediation: Require exactly one structurally valid candidate in the complete set and a valid in-window target before mutation; remove unbound zero-candidate Return.
findings.verification: The seven-case matrix must produce zero target action, Return, draft, and submit for all unsafe sets while retaining the ambiguity control.
